brief: Inspect Underhill Bluff before the heat event, noting that its advanced age of 54 years reduces its margin against mechanical failure under thermal stress (MG-023). Because this asset has ONAN cooling and the documents do not cover forced cooling operations for this type, apply the ambient and sustained event loading restrictions outlined in MG-021. Record every de-rating applied along with its reason, value, and period in accordance with MG-021.
